notes: S. 3705 (enacted as Public Law 119-79, approved Feb. 18, 2026) is a two-section ceremonial act directing the Architect of the Capitol to create the Semiquincentennial Congressional Time Capsule, sealed and buried in the Capitol Visitor Center on or before July 4, 2026 (timed with the Independence Mall, Philadelphia burial under sec. 7(f)(1) of the U.S. Semiquincentennial Commission Act of 2016), and sealed until July 4, 2276, when the Speaker and Senate Majority Leader present it to the 244th Congress. Every substantive bill-content claim (dimensions 50/32/48 in., the four leadership offices, single joint letter, low-degradation materials, plaque, both approving committees, both dates, the 244th Congress) traces verbatim to SEC. 2; no figure error, direction inversion, wrong-account, or fabricated-entity issue found. Committees are correctly mapped (Senate Rules & Administration / House Administration, not swapped) and the four offices correctly exclude any House Majority Leader. likelihoodReason sponsor/vote facts (Tillis R-NC; UC in Senate, Voice Vote in House; PL 119-79) are not in the bill text and were checked against cache metadata/votes[] per rubric step-4 (empty sourceSpan). Non-material items only: 'narrow ceremonial measure' is an unsourced editorial gloss (minor framing); gaps[2] 'where ... stored' is slightly loose since the burial site (Capitol Visitor Center) IS specified; one minor coverage omission — the SEC. 2(b)(4) discretionary consultation option (Architect, Secretary of the Smithsonian Institution, other federal entities) is not surfaced. Also not surfaced: SEC. 2(d) provision that the 244th Congress 'shall determine how the contents ... should be preserved or used' (implied by 'opened/presented'). 0 material issues.
